title: aethionema heterophyllum
intro: Aethionema heterophyllum, commonly known as Rock Jasmine, is a flowering plant species in the family Brassicaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and anxiety. The therapeutic actions of Rock Jasmine include its sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, which help to calm the mind and body. The bioactive constituents of Aethionema heterophyllum include saponins, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
